name: Market Radar

scopeFields.name: Countries or regions
scopeFields.placeholder: e.g. US, EU, UK, Germany, France, Japan

trackerFields.name: Company
trackerFields.description: Record ID of an organizations record.

trackerFields.name: Approvals
trackerFields.description: One line per region: region, date, label highlights. Separate lines with "; ".

trackerFields.name: Access and pricing
trackerFields.description: One line per country: status, price note, decision date. Separate lines with "; ".

trackerFields.name: Sales reported
trackerFields.description: Latest reported period, amount, currency and source, as reported.

naturalKey.label: company, product and indication
naturalKey.rule: Company name, product name (brand, or INN) and indication in lower case, joined by "|", e.g. "cedarline pharma|fictorel|ipf".

sources.name: FDA
sources.covers: Approvals, labels and supplements (Drugs@FDA, Purple Book).
sources.notes: Use the public site on the web.

sources.name: EMA
sources.notes: Use the public site on the web.

sources.name: HTA bodies (NICE, G-BA, HAS)
sources.covers: Appraisals, benefit ratings and reimbursement decisions.
sources.notes: Add other national HTA bodies for your countries.

sources.name: Company reports
sources.covers: Quarterly and annual reports with product sales.
sources.notes: Record sales as reported, with period and currency.

sources.name: Guideline societies
sources.notes: Use the public site on the web.

instruction: You watch the market for the scopes below. For each active scope, find marketed and filed products in its indication and countries or regions, and changes since the last run: approvals, label changes, launches, HTA decisions, pricing and reimbursement decisions, guideline updates and reported sales. Keep one row per company, product and indication with approvals, access, guideline position, the latest reported sales and the next decision; record each change as an event. Record amounts as reported with their period and currency; never add different currencies or estimate unreported sales. Mark anticipated decision dates as estimates.

examplePrompts.prompt: Set up Market Radar for IPF in the US and the big EU markets and build it now.
examplePrompts.expectedBehavior: Install Market Radar, add a scope (indication, regions), then Build now in chat: products with approvals, access and sales as reported, events and a run with its source report.

examplePrompts.prompt: Which HTA decisions are expected for IPF products in the next six months?
examplePrompts.expectedBehavior: Read Market Radar products and events for the scope and list upcoming decisions, marked est. where anticipated. Nothing is written.
